name: markdown-view
title: Markdown View
description: Renders Markdown (CommonMark, GFM tables, tasks and strikethrough, [[wikilinks]] and ![[embeds]]) to React elements with the Lezer parser, fenced code as a highlighted CodeBlock: raw HTML shows as text, only http, https, mailto and tel links become links, leading YAML frontmatter is hidden or shown as properties, and each top-level block is memoised so long notes re-render only what changed. Also extractHeadings for an outline and parseFrontmatter.

docs: Wikilinks: `resolveWikilink(target)` returns `{ exists, label }` (an unresolved link is dashed), `wikilinkHref(target)` its address, and `onWikilinkClick(target, event)` takes plain clicks and agents' `follow` for client routing (modified clicks stay with the browser). A wikilink with an address renders through `Link`, so it follows on press and hash routes (`#/note/x`) work; one without an address but with `onWikilinkClick` is a button. Both carry `data-wikilink` (`link` or `embed`) and `data-target`. Embeds: `![[target]]` and `![[target|alias]]` render `renderEmbed(target, alias)`, as a block when the embed is alone in its paragraph; without it, a dashed link-like chip. Frontmatter: a `---` block on the first line, closed by `---` or `...`, is hidden by default (`frontmatter="hide"`), a `<dl>` of its `key: value` lines and lists with `frontmatter="properties"` (named by `frontmatterLabel`, "Properties"), or its YAML with `"raw"`; `renderFrontmatter({ raw, properties, from, to })` draws your own. `parseFrontmatter(markdown)` reads it without a YAML dependency: plain `key: value` lines, `- item` and `[a, b]` lists, `|` and `>` blocks; nested maps are skipped, and `raw` is there for a real YAML parser. `extractHeadings(markdown)` lists `{ level, text, slug, line, from, to, textFrom }`, frontmatter and code left out, for an outline. `slug` is unique in the document (GitHub's rule: lowercased, punctuation dropped, spaces as `-`, `-1`, `-2`… after a repeat, `heading` for an empty one), and the view puts the same slug on each rendered heading as `data-slug`, so a filtered list still finds its heading. Keep the callbacks stable (module-level or `useCallback`): a new function re-renders every block. Images reserve their box before they load when their size is known: write it in the alt text as Obsidian does (`![A chart|640x360](chart.png)`, or `|640` for the width), or answer `imageSize(src, alt)` with `{ width, height }`; without either, the text below moves when the image arrives.
